root_cause.text: Off-by-one error in the bound check in `hvc_iucv_get_private()` where the condition `num > hvc_iucv_devices` allows an out-of-bounds array access when `hvc_iucv_devices` equals the array size `MAX_HVC_IUCV_LINES` (8), because valid indices are 0 to `hvc_iucv_devices - 1`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (num > hvc_iucv_devices)` to `if (num >= hvc_iucv_devices)` in `hvc_iucv_get_private()`. The commit message explicitly states that when `hvc_iucv_devices == 8`, the old check permits accessing `hvc_iucv_table[8]`, which is out of bounds as the array has only 8 entries (indices 0-7).
